senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. אָצַר) [to press,] to close up; to detain; to ward off; to gather, store away.
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 38a:1">Succ. 38ᵃ</cite> <he>עוֹצֶרֶת רוחות וכ׳</he> wards off evil winds and dews (v. infra).

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19">Num. R. s. 19</cite> <he>היאך יכול … וַעֲצָרוֹ</he> how could the angel of death strike a man that had stood up against the angel of death and warded him off? (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 17:13">Num. XVII, 13</cite>).

<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 151:1">Sifré Num. 151</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 782:20">Yalk. ib. 782</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="P01136"><he>עצרת</he></cite>, <cite ref="Numbers 29:35">Num. XXIX, 35</cite>) <he>עֲצָרוֹ הכתוב מלצאת</he> the Scripture keeps him (the pilgrim) from leaving (Jerusalem, on the eighth day). Pesik. R. (ed. Fr.) addit. s. 4; Pesik. Bayom, p. 193ᵇ <he>הק״בה עוֹצֵר וכ׳</he> the Lord locks his Presence up with them, v. infra.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 71a:4">Ab. Zar. 71ᵃ</cite> <he>עול תחתי לעוֹצֵר</he>, v. <cite ref="P00815"><he>עָלַל</he></cite>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="P01110"><he>עָצוּר</he></cite>; f. <cite ref="P01108"><he>עֲצוּרָה</he></cite>; pl. <cite ref="P01112"><he>עֲצוּרִים</he></cite>, <he>עְצוּרִין</he>; <he>עְצוּרוֹת</he>. Sifré l. c. <he>מה זה ע׳ מלצאת אף זה ע׳ וכ׳</he> as on this (the eighth day) one is prohibited to leave, so is one on this (the first day).

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 135:1">Sifré Deut. 135</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="P01136"><he>עצרת</he></cite>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 16:8">Deut. XVI, 8</cite>) <he>יכול יהא אדם ע׳ כל וכ׳</he> from this you might infer that one must be confined the whole day in the schoolhouse (for religious exercises).

<cite ref="Deuteronomy 16:8">Ib.</cite> <he>מה שביעי ע׳ אף ששי ע׳</he> as the seventh day is under restrictions (as to week-day labor), so is the sixth day (i.e. the days intervening between the first and the seventh day); <he>אי מה שביעי ע׳ מכל מלאכה וכ׳</he> you might infer from this that as the seventh day is under restriction as regards all sorts of labor (even work of necessity), so is the sixth; <cite ref="Chagigah 18a:2">Ḥag. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>השביעי ע׳ בכל מלאכה … ימים ע׳ וכ׳</he> the seventh day is under a general restriction, but the six days are not; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 904:5">Yalk. Deut. 904</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 907:1">ib. 907</cite>.

<cite ref="Chullin 67a:7">Ḥull. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>בורות … שהן ע׳ ככלים</he> wells, pits and caves, the waters of which are restrained as in vessels; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 537:6">Yalk. Lev. 537</cite> <he>עצירים … בכלים</he> (corr. acc.); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be detained; to be gathered together. Pesik. R. l. c. כל זמן שישראל נֶעֱצָרִין וכ׳ as long as Israel holds festive gatherings in synagogues and schoolhouses, the Lord locks up &c. (v. supra); Pesik. l. c.ᵃ מְעַצְּרִין (Pi.).
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 782:25">Yalk. Num. 782</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="P01136"><he>עצרת</he></cite>, v. supra) <he>למה נֶעֶצְרוּ עיד יום אחד</he> why are they detained one more day? <cite ref="Taanit 7b:5">Taan. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>הגשמים נעצרין</he> the rains are withheld.
<cite ref="Taanit 8a:18">Ib. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>השמים נעצרין מלהוריד וכ׳</he> the heavens are locked up so as not to let down rain &c.; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to hold festive gatherings. Pesik. l. c., v. supra.

units: <cite ref="Sukkah 37b:10">Succ. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>כדי לעַצֵּר רוחות וכ׳</he> in order to keep off evil winds &c. (v. supra).
